description: This file defines the CreditCardPayment class, a subclass of Payment, modeling credit card payment details including card number, validation number, expiration date, owner, and type.

classes.name: CreditCardPayment
classes.description: Represents a credit card payment, extending Payment, with fields for card details and methods to access them.

methods.name: getCredidCardValidationNumber
methods.description: Returns the credit card validation number.

methods.name: setCredidCardValidationNumber
methods.description: Sets the credit card validation number.

methods.name: getExpirationMonth
methods.description: Returns the expiration month of the credit card.

methods.name: setExpirationMonth
methods.description: Sets the expiration month of the credit card.

methods.name: getExpirationYear
methods.description: Returns the expiration year of the credit card.

methods.name: setExpirationYear
methods.description: Sets the expiration year of the credit card.

methods.name: getCardOwner
methods.description: Returns the owner of the credit card.

methods.name: setCardOwner
methods.description: Sets the owner of the credit card.

methods.name: getCreditCard
methods.description: Returns the CreditCardType associated with this payment.

methods.name: setCreditCard
methods.description: Sets the CreditCardType associated with this payment.
